The profile is encrypted with the password. After you log out, it opens only with the password.
The profile is still encrypted, with a key kept on this phone. It opens without a password for whoever can unlock this phone, and only here.
At least 8 characters, with a letter and a digit.
The password is shorter than 8 characters.
The password needs a letter and a digit.
Type the password again in the second field.

Send your ID to the people you want to write to, or show them the QR code.
This profile opens without a password, on this phone only.
There are no servers, and only you know the password. A new profile gets a new ID and takes this one\'s place: this profile, its contacts and its history are deleted from the phone.
Wrong password. Check the keyboard language and Caps Lock.
The profile file is damaged. If you have an exported copy, move the profile in from it.
No access to the profile file. Restart the phone and try again.
Check the name and the ID. The file holds the ID and the contacts; the chat history is not in it.
This is not a Khandaq profile file. Choose a .tox file exported from a profile.
This file is protected by a password. Khandaq for Android can move in only a profile file saved without a password.
On this phone the profile opens without a password, with a key kept here. A password can be set later in Profile, Password and PIN.
